name: devyonq-mc
description: Mission Control v1.7 for GitHub Copilot, in the Copilot CLI and in VS Code: the creation, verification, approval, review and closure skills, the client mc17 that sends their commands to the harness in DevyonQ, the hook gates, which each client runs through hooks/dialect.py with a dialect file of its own, and the custom agent mc-independent, which the review and rewriting skills start in a context of its own. Waves run by hand on Copilot: the package carries no fleet runner.
